description.en: Bridges between DeepSeek Harness and local CAD/modeling software (AutoCAD, Rhino, SketchUp, Blender).
description.zh: 连接 DeepSeek Harness 与本机 CAD/建模软件（AutoCAD、Rhino、SketchUp、Blender）的桥接插件。

description.en: Connect AutoCAD, Rhino, SketchUp, and Blender to DeepSeek Harness through three AgentBridge MCP servers (hostmcp/cadmcp/agentbridge): read drawings, interpret layer and room semantics, and drive modeling software with permissioned, rollback-capable writes.
description.zh: 通过三个 AgentBridge MCP 服务器（hostmcp/cadmcp/agentbridge）把 AutoCAD、Rhino、SketchUp、Blender 接入 DeepSeek Harness：读取图纸、解释图层与房间语义，并以带权限票据和回滚能力的方式驱动建模软件。
